questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.answer: I wanted to study and live in a Spanish speaking country.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Somewhat easy.

questions.answer: The UAB’s Erasmus team was very helpful and arranged info meetings.

Additional comments

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: The app Badi was very useful.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I enjoyed living in BCN, as I wanted to get to know the city. If possible living close to a FGC station (S2 or S6 lines go to UAB) is the smartest.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Don’t expect to get the classes you’ve looked at from home.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The Erasmus office is helpful.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don’t hesitate to ask professors and other students to find out which courses you should chose - there is a ‘transfer window’ at the start of the semester where you can sign up for courses.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Much lower than at the UCPH

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I would compare it to Danish Gymnasium style

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Comparative literature, Shakespeare y su tiempo, cultural studies, north-American literature, Victorian literature.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: North-American literature, Shakespeare
